prompt: Which query returns exactly the 2 most expensive products of each category, by unit cost, in the columns category_id, product_id and unit_cost_eur? When products tie on unit cost, the lower product_id comes first, and a category with one product keeps it.

options.text:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2

WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
